findings.claim: addons/media_import/backend/subscription/providers/youtube.py now imports `...service` at module level (`from ...service import JS_RUNTIME_OPTIONS`). Before, that module imported service only lazily inside functions. This changes the provider module's import graph, which goes beyond the touch point's 'every options dict'.
findings.impact: No user impact is visible. service.py imports nothing from `subscription` at module level (only lazily, at lines 651 and 1187), so no import cycle exists today. But importing the YouTube provider now loads all of service.py and its core `app.*` imports. A later module-level import of the subscription package from service.py would create a cycle that the touch points do not warn about.
findings.evidence: providers/youtube.py:57 adds the module-level import. The same file at lines 262 and 271 keeps the earlier lazy `from ...service import _fetch_metadata_sync` / `_download_captions_sync` inside functions. service.py:35 is its only relative module-level import (`.schemas`). manager.py:37 already imported service at module level, so for manager this is not new.

bucket_proposal.reason: No invariant is broken and no cycle exists now. This is an unplanned structural reach inside a listed file.

findings.proposed_fix: Name the shared JS_RUNTIME_OPTIONS constant in service.py, and the new module-level import of it in providers/youtube.py, in the touch points, or define the dict locally in each of the three files.
